mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within a month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals a weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of observed periods despite the signal, or the correlation between RSAFS declines and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within two months signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a tightening labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the interaction effect between PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% within two months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between HOUST decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% over a quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 0.5% in the same period, it signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 grows < 1% and INDPRO decreases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the interaction effect between GDPC1 growth and INDPRO decreases on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
